items_flat.title_en: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5.5, first model in the Claude 5.5 family
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Opus 5.5，Claude 5.5系列首款模型
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5.5 as available today, calling it the first model in a new Claude 5.5 family. Official copy says it performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 for most work and costs about 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads. API list prices are $4 / $20 per million input / output tokens, with cache reads at $0.20; Fast mode is $8 / $40. Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are promised in the coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布Claude Opus 5.5即日起可用，為新Claude 5.5系列第一款模型。官方稱多數工作表現達Claude Fable 5.1水準，典型負載成本較Opus 5約低40%。API標價為每百萬token輸入4美元、輸出20美元，快取讀取0.20美元；Fast mode為8／40美元。Sonnet 5.5與Haiku 5.5預計數週內推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a mid-cycle price/performance squeeze on Anthropic’s daily-driver Opus tier, not a claimed new intelligence peak: the pitch is Fable-class utility at a cheaper Opus bill, with thinking always on and several breaking API changes. Independent confirmation of the coding-cost claims versus GPT-6 Astra/Sol still sits with vendor benches.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對日常主力Opus檔的中期性價比加壓，而非宣稱新的智力巔峰：賣點是Fable級實用性搭配更便宜的Opus帳單，思考預設常開且有多項破壞性API變更。相對GPT-6 Astra／Sol的編碼成本主張，仍主要來自官方基準。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family. It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出Claude Opus 5.5，這是新Claude 5.5系列的第一款模型。多數工作表現達Claude Fable 5.1水準，運行成本較Opus 5低40%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands GPT-6 with Sol and Luna, cuts API prices 50%
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Sol與Luna，API價格較5.6促銷價砍半
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as faster, cheaper siblings that it says were trained with similar methods to GPT-6 Astra. API prices fall 50% versus GPT-5.6 promotional rates: Sol to $2 / $10 per million input / output tokens, Luna to $0.10 / $0.50. Both rolled out in the API and in ChatGPT Work and Codex for paid tiers; Free and Go users can try Luna in the desktop app. Astra remains the top GPT-6 model.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Sol與GPT-6 Luna，稱以與GPT-6 Astra相近方法訓練、更快更便宜。API價格較GPT-5.6促銷價降50%：Sol為每百萬token輸入2美元、輸出10美元，Luna為0.10／0.50美元。兩者已上API，並在ChatGPT Work與Codex向付費方案推出；Free與Go可在桌面版試用Luna。Astra仍為GPT-6旗艦。
items_flat.analysis_en: OpenAI is productizing Astra’s generation as a cost ladder rather than waiting for another flagship: Sol is positioned as the scaled workhorse, Luna as high-volume cheap inference. Independent scoring so far describes intelligence as roughly level with GPT-5.6 counterparts, so the day’s move is price and serving efficiency more than a new capability ceiling.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI把Astra這一代做成成本階梯，而非再等下一款旗艦：Sol定位規模化主力，Luna定位高量低價推論。目前獨立評分大致與GPT-5.6對應檔持平，故本日重點是價格與服務效率，而非新的能力上限。
items_flat.quote: We’ve also made caching and inference more efficient, and we’re passing the savings directly to you: 50% lower API prices for Sol and Luna compared with GPT‑5.6 promotional pricing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們也提升了快取與推論效率，並把節省直接回饋給你們：Sol與Luna的API價格較GPT-5.6促銷價低50%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes priorities for independent third-party safety assessments
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI公布獨立第三方安全評估的優先事項與原則
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a safety post committing to support independent assessments with access across training, evaluation, and deployment, framed as part of its effort to “pace the frontier.” The note lists four priority areas: safety cases; critical safeguards under grey-box access; Preparedness Framework capability evaluations; and investigation of misalignment incidents. It also lists principles on independence, rigor, security, and how findings may be published after a fix window.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布安全文，承諾支援涵蓋訓練、評估與部署的獨立評估，並將其納入「放緩前沿節奏」努力。文件列出四項優先領域：安全論證、灰盒下的關鍵防護、Preparedness Framework能力評估，以及錯位事件調查；並提出獨立性、嚴謹、安全與修復後再公開發現的原則。
items_flat.analysis_en: This converts a recent executive pledge into a process document, not a completed audit: it defines what OpenAI wants assessors to look at and how findings might be handled, while leaving partners, access terms, and dates unnamed. Talks with groups such as METR and Redwood Research were reported by press, not confirmed as signed programs in the post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是把近期高層承諾寫成流程文件，而非已完成的審計：定義OpenAI希望評估方檢視什麼、發現如何處理，但未點名夥伴、權限條款或時程。媒體稱正與METR、Redwood Research洽談，官方文本身未確認已簽約計畫。
items_flat.quote: As part of our efforts to pace the frontier, OpenAI is committed to supporting independent assessments with deep levels of access across training, evaluation, and deployment.
items_flat.quote_zh: 作為放緩前沿節奏努力的一部分，OpenAI承諾支援在訓練、評估與部署各階段提供深度存取的獨立評估。

items_flat.title_en: Xiaomi open-sources MiMo-V2.6 Pro and Flash omnimodal models
items_flat.title_zh: 小米開源MiMo-V2.6 Pro與Flash原生全模態模型
items_flat.summary_en: Xiaomi released and open-sourced the MiMo-V2.6 series on September 22, including natively omnimodal MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash, plus a Pro-UltraSpeed serving mode it says can reach up to 20x output speed. Official copy says Pro scored 46.32 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ahead of named open-weight rivals while still trailing top closed models, and kept V2.5-series API pricing. Weights, a technical report, 7,000-plus RL task environments, and Distill-Qwen-9B were published.
items_flat.summary_zh: 小米於9月22日發布並開源MiMo-V2.6系列，含原生全模態的MiMo-V2.6-Pro與MiMo-V2.6-Flash，以及宣稱輸出可達約20倍速的Pro-UltraSpeed服務模式。官方稱Pro在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index拿下46.32，領先點名開源對手、仍落後頂尖閉源模型，API價維持V2.5系列。權重、技術報告、7,000餘個RL任務環境與Distill-Qwen-9B一併公開。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the day’s notable open-weights move: a Chinese lab claiming the open-source intelligence lead while holding price flat. The 46.32 index figure and the closed-model gap Xiaomi itself flags should be read as vendor-cited ranking, not a settled frontier claim, until independent reruns land.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是當日最值得記的開源權重動作：中國實驗室自稱開源智力領先、同時維持原價。46.32指數與官方自己標出的閉源差距，在獨立複測落地前應視為廠商引用排名，而非已定論的前沿主張。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing and open-sourcing the MiMo-V2.6 series. This marks a key step in our exploration of the RSI path: scaling RL compute on verifiable, complex tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們發布並開源MiMo-V2.6系列。這是探索RSI路徑的關鍵一步：在可驗證的複雜任務上擴展強化學習算力。

brief_en: Sep 23 Taipei: Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5 at Fable-class utility and ~40% lower typical cost. OpenAI added GPT-6 Sol and Luna with 50% API cuts versus GPT-5.6 promo rates, plus a process note on third-party safety access. Xiaomi open-sourced omnimodal MiMo-V2.6 Pro/Flash.
brief_zh: 台北9/23：Anthropic推出Claude Opus 5.5，宣稱多數工作達Fable級、典型成本較Opus 5約低40%。OpenAI推出GPT-6 Sol與Luna並將API價較5.6促銷價砍半，另公布第三方安全評估優先事項。小米開源MiMo-V2.6 Pro/Flash。
